pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should be done with extra fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Leave them to rot
   B. Share or sell them and avoid wasting
   C. Bury them
   D. Throw them away

2. Why should you tie a knot in the thread before tacking? (1 mark)
   A. So that the thread stays in the cloth
   B. So the needle does not move
   C. To make the cloth stiffer
   D. To make the thread thicker

3. Where should you start mopping? (1 mark)
   A. At the corner farthest from the door
   B. Outside
   C. Next to the door
   D. In the middle

4. How do you place pins for tacking? (1 mark)
   A. Along the line
   B. Only at the edge
   C. Across the line
   D. Not at all

5. How wet should a compost heap be? (1 mark)
   A. Dripping wet
   B. Covered by a pool of water
   C. Completely dry
   D. Damp like a squeezed sponge

6. What does variety mean in eating? (1 mark)
   A. Eating a lot
   B. Eating one food only
   C. Eating many different kinds of food
   D. Eating slowly

7. Which animal browses on leaves and shoots from bushes? (1 mark)
   A. Duck
   B. Goat
   C. Hen
   D. Rabbit only

8. Which food may be served with boiled potatoes for a balanced meal? (1 mark)
   A. A second helping of potatoes only
   B. Vegetable stew
   C. Sugar
   D. Soda only

9. Which of these can oxen do on a farm? (1 mark)
   A. Lay eggs
   B. Produce honey
   C. Give wool
   D. Pull ploughs and carts

10. Why should potatoes be cut into pieces of equal size before boiling? (1 mark)
   A. To waste time
   B. To make them bigger
   C. To make them cold
   D. They cook at the same time

11. Which animal is not domestic? (1 mark)
   A. Hen
   B. Goat
   C. Cow
   D. Elephant

12. What is a fruit? (1 mark)
   A. The stem of a plant
   B. The part of a plant that holds the seeds
   C. The roots of a plant
   D. The leaves of a plant

13. Why is dry grass laid lightly over a seedbed? (1 mark)
   A. It keeps moisture and protects seeds from rain and birds
   B. It makes seeds fly
   C. It makes the soil hard
   D. It stops seeds growing

14. Why is the water container placed on a stand? (1 mark)
   A. So it looks tall
   B. To keep it out of the sun forever
   C. So water flows down through the pipe
   D. To hide it from birds

15. Why is mulch put around a young tree? (1 mark)
   A. It kills roots
   B. It keeps the soil moist and controls weeds
   C. It stops flowering
   D. It makes the tree shorter

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three reasons why nails should be kept short and clean. (3 marks)

17. Describe how to clean gumboots. (4 marks)

18. How can you tell that compost is ready for use? (3 marks)

19. Explain why a tippy tap is useful in a school without a tap. (3 marks)

20. Explain why tacking thread should be loose. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Share or sell them and avoid wasting
   Extra fruits can earn money or feed others.

2. A — So that the thread stays in the cloth
   A knot stops the thread pulling through.

3. A — At the corner farthest from the door
   You do not step on the clean floor.

4. C — Across the line
   Pins across the line hold the layers.

5. D — Damp like a squeezed sponge
   Too dry stops rotting and too wet makes the heap smell sour.

6. C — Eating many different kinds of food
   Variety means different foods.

7. B — Goat
   Goats browse on shrubs.

8. B — Vegetable stew
   Vegetables add protective foods.

9. D — Pull ploughs and carts
   Oxen give draught power.

10. D — They cook at the same time
   Equal pieces cook evenly.

11. D — Elephant
   Elephants are wild.

12. B — The part of a plant that holds the seeds
   Fruits grow from flowers and hold seeds.

13. A — It keeps moisture and protects seeds from rain and birds
   Mulch protects the surface.

14. C — So water flows down through the pipe
   A raised container gives water the push to flow down.

15. B — It keeps the soil moist and controls weeds
   Mulch reduces evaporation.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Germs hide under nails, worm eggs are found there, and long nails can scratch and cause injury.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Knock off lumps of mud; rinse; scrub with a soft brush and soapy water inside and outside; rinse again; dry upside down in the shade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is dark brown, crumbly, smells like earth, and the original wastes cannot be seen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sign.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It saves water, it can be made cheaply from a container, and children do not touch the container with dirty hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tight thread pulls and wrinkles the cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pulls, 1 mark for wrinkles.
